title: Low-level N-nitrosamine occurrence in disinfected drinking water and relationships with standard water quality indicators
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00861A, Paper
Open Access

Kristen A. Riedinger, Nicolette A. Bugher, Annabella S. Wardle, Kathleen M. Vandiver, Barathkumar Baskaran, Zion Michael, Glen Andrew D. de Vera, Desiree L. Plata
N-Nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA), a probable human carcinogen, and other N-nitrosamines were measured in drinking water, and their relationships with standard water quality indicators were investigated.
